title: LeetCode SQL
description: Учебный план SQL 50: 50 задач LeetCode в семи тематических блоках. Каждый шаг — SQLite-практика с русским условием, ссылкой на LeetCode и автопроверкой в браузере (sql.js).

steps.title: Диалект SQLite и проверка
steps.content:
## Курс LeetCode SQL 50

Задачи с [LeetCode Study Plan SQL 50](https://leetcode.com/studyplan/top-sql-50/) адаптированы под **SQLite 3** (sql.js в браузере).

### Даты и время

| MySQL | SQLite |
|-------|--------|
| `DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m')` | `strftime('%Y-%m', d)` |
| `DATEDIFF(a, b)` | `julianday(a) - julianday(b)` |
| `DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)` | `DATE(d, '+1 day')` |

### Строки и regex

- `CONCAT(a, b)` → `a || b` или `printf('%s%s', a, b)`
- Оператор **`REGEXP`** в приложении — семантика **JavaScript** `RegExp` (регистрозависимый).

### Проверка

- Сравнивается **последний** result set с колонками.
- **`checkColumnNames: true`** — имена столбцов как на LeetCode.
- **`orderMatters: true`** — порядок строк важен.
- **`checkQuery`** — для UPDATE/DELETE проверяется состояние таблиц после запроса.
- Задачи «функция» (Nth Salary): параметр в таблице **`params`** через `seed`.

### Ссылки

В каждой задаче — номер LeetCode и ссылка на оригинал.

steps.title: Фильтрация и проекция
steps.content:
## SELECT

- **`WHERE`**: `AND` / `OR`, не забывайте **`IS NULL`**.
- **`DISTINCT`**, **`ORDER BY`**, **`LIMIT`**.
- SQLite: `LENGTH(text)` вместо `CHAR_LENGTH`.

content.description:
Выведите `product_id` товаров, которые **одновременно** low fat (`low_fats = 1`) и recyclable (`recyclable = 1`).

[LeetCode 1757](https://leetcode.com/problems/recyclable-and-low-fat-products/)

content.description:
Выведите `name` клиентов, которые **не** были приглашены referee с `id = 2`. Если `referee_id` NULL — клиент тоже подходит.

[LeetCode 584](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-customer-referee/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Customer(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, referee_id INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT name FROM Customer WHERE referee_id <> 2;

content.description:

[LeetCode 595](https://leetcode.com/problems/big-countries/)

steps.title: JOIN и NULL в связях
steps.content:
## JOIN

- **`INNER JOIN`** — только совпадения.
- **`LEFT JOIN`** — все строки слева; нет пары → NULL справа.
- Сравнение дат: `DATE(col, "+1 day")` в SQLite.

content.caption: LEFT JOIN сохраняет левую таблицу
content.description: Для «никогда не …» часто LEFT JOIN + `IS NULL`.

steps.title: 1378. Replace Employee ID With The Unique Identifier

content.description:
Свяжите `Employees` и `EmployeeUNI` по `id`. Верните `unique_id` и `name`; если unique_id нет — NULL.

[LeetCode 1378](https://leetcode.com/problems/replace-employee-id-with-the-unique-identifier/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employees(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE EmployeeUNI(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, unique_id INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT e.id AS unique_id, e.name FROM Employees e INNER JOIN EmployeeUNI u ON e.id = u.id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT u.unique_id, e.name FROM Employees e LEFT JOIN EmployeeUNI u ON e.id = u.id;

content.description:
Средний `experience_years` по каждому `project_id`, округлённый до **2** знаков, колонка `average_years`.

[LeetCode 1075](https://leetcode.com/problems/project-employees-i/)

CREATE TABLE Project(project_id INTEGER NOT NULL, employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project_id, employee_id));
CREATE TABLE Employee(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, experience_years INTEGER NOT NULL);

content.description:
Имена сотрудников с `bonus < 1000` (или bonus NULL). Колонки: `Employee`, `Bonus`.

[LeetCode 577](https://leetcode.com/problems/employee-bonus/)

CREATE TABLE Employee(empId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, supervisor INTEGER, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Bonus(empId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bonus INTEGER);

steps.title: 570. Managers with at Least 5 Direct Reports

content.description:
Имена менеджеров, у которых **≥ 5** прямых подчинённых (`managerId`).

[LeetCode 570](https://leetcode.com/problems/managers-with-at-least-5-direct-reports/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, department TEXT, managerId INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT name FROM Employee WHERE id IN (SELECT managerId FROM Employee);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT name FROM Employee WHERE id IN (SELECT managerId FROM Employee GROUP BY managerId HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5);

content.description:
Для каждой пары студент × предмет выведите `student_id`, `student_name`, `subject_name` и `attended_exams` — сколько раз студент сдавал экзамен по этому предмету (0, если не сдавал). Сортировка: `student_id`, затем `subject_name`.

[LeetCode 1280](https://leetcode.com/problems/students-and-examinations/)
content.starterCode: SELECT student_id, student_name, subject_name, COUNT(*) AS attended_exams FROM Examinations GROUP BY student_id, subject_name;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name, COUNT(e.student_id) AS attended_exams FROM Students s CROSS JOIN Subjects sub LEFT JOIN Examinations e ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND sub.subject_name = e.subject_name GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name ORDER BY s.student_id, sub.subject_name;

content.description:
Для каждого `user_id` — `confirmation_rate`: доля `confirmed` среди **timeout** и **confirmed** (rounded to 2 decimals). Нет таких действий → `0.00`.

[LeetCode 1934](https://leetcode.com/problems/confirmation-rate/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Signups(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, time_stamp TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Confirmations(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, time_stamp TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, 1.0 AS confirmation_rate FROM Signups;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT s.user_id, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.action = "confirmed") * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(c.action IN ("confirmed","timeout")), 0), 0), 2) AS confirmation_rate FROM Signups s LEFT JOIN Confirmations c ON s.user_id = c.user_id GROUP BY s.user_id;

steps.title: Агрегаты и FILTER
steps.content:
## Агрегаты

`COUNT`, `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN`, `MAX`. `COUNT(DISTINCT x)`. Условная агрегация: `SUM(CASE WHEN …)` или `COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …)` (SQLite 3.30+).

content.caption: GROUP BY сворачивает строки
content.description: Без GROUP BY агрегат по всей таблице.
content.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 280 80" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Basic Aggregate Functions"><rect id="lsq03-box" x="40" y="15" width="200" height="50" rx="4" fill="#e3f2fd" stroke="#1565c0"/><text x="140" y="45" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#0d47a1">Basic Aggregate Functions</text></svg>

content.description:
Фильмы: нечётный `id`, `description` **не** «boring», сортировка по `rating` **убыванию**.

[LeetCode 620](https://leetcode.com/problems/not-boring-movies/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Cinema(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, movie TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, rating REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT * FROM Cinema ORDER BY rating DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT * FROM Cinema WHERE id % 2 = 1 AND description != 'boring' ORDER BY rating DESC;

tests.seed: INSERT INTO Cinema VALUES (1,'War','great 3D',8.9),(2,'Science','fiction',8.5),(3,'irish','boring',6.2),(4,'Ice song','Fantacy',8.6),(5,'House card','Interesting',9.1);

content.description:
Средняя цена продажи каждого `product_id` за период (Units с `purchase_date` между «2019-01-01» и «2019-06-30»). Колонка `average_price`, округление 2 знака; нет продаж → NULL.

[LeetCode 1251](https://leetcode.com/problems/average-selling-price/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Units(product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, purchase_date TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, AVG(price) AS average_price FROM Products GROUP BY product_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT p.product_id, ROUND(AVG(u.amount * p.price * 1.0) / NULLIF(SUM(u.amount), 0), 2) AS average_price FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Units u ON p.product_id = u.product_id AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN "2019-01-01" AND "2019-06-30" GROUP BY p.product_id;

steps.title: 1661. Average Time of Process per Machine

content.description:
Среднее время обработки (`processing_time`, округление **3** знака) для каждой `machine_id`: по каждой паре `(machine_id, process_id)` время = `end` − `start`, затем среднее по машине.

[LeetCode 1661](https://leetcode.com/problems/average-time-of-process-per-machine/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(machine_id INTEGER NOT NULL, process_id INTEGER NOT NULL, activity_type TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT machine_id, AVG(timestamp) AS processing_time FROM Activity GROUP BY machine_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT machine_id, ROUND(AVG(end_time - start_time), 3) AS processing_time FROM (SELECT machine_id, process_id, MAX(CASE WHEN activity_type = "start" THEN timestamp END) AS start_time, MAX(CASE WHEN activity_type = "end" THEN timestamp END) AS end_time FROM Activity GROUP BY machine_id, process_id) t GROUP BY machine_id;

steps.title: 1633. Percentage of Users Attended a Contest

content.description:
Доля пользователей, участвовавших в **хотя бы одном** контесте (`registered_in_contest`), округлить до 2 знаков — `percentage`.

[LeetCode 1633](https://leetcode.com/problems/percentage-of-users-attended-a-contest/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Register(contest_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(contest_id, user_id));
content.starterCode: SELECT 100.0 AS percentage;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Users), 2) AS percentage FROM Register r;

tests.seed:
INSERT INTO Users VALUES (6,"Alice"),(2,"Bob"),(7,"Alex");
INSERT INTO Register VALUES (215,6),(209,2),(208,2);

content.description:
По `(month, country)`: `approved_count`, `approved_amount` (только state approved), `chargeback_count`, `chargeback_amount` (только chargeback). Месяц — `YYYY-MM` из `trans_date`.

[LeetCode 1193](https://leetcode.com/problems/monthly-transactions-i/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Transactions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, country TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, trans_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT country, trans_date FROM Transactions;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT strftime("%Y-%m", trans_date) AS month, country,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN state = "approved" THEN 1 END) AS approved_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN state = "approved" THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_amount,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN state = "chargeback" THEN 1 END) AS chargeback_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN state = "chargeback" THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS chargeback_amount
FROM Transactions GROUP BY month, country ORDER BY month, country;

content.description:
Доля заказов первого заказа клиента (`order_number=1`), доставленных в **первый** день (`order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date`), в процентах `immediate_percentage` (2 знака).

[LeetCode 1174](https://leetcode.com/problems/immediate-food-delivery-ii/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Delivery(delivery_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_date TEXT NOT NULL, customer_pref_delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL, delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT 100 AS immediate_percentage;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(SUM(order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS immediate_percentage FROM Delivery WHERE (customer_id, order_date) IN (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) FROM Delivery GROUP BY customer_id);

content.description:
Доля игроков, которые заходили **на следующий календарный день** после дня первого входа. Одна строка: `fraction` (округлить 2 знака).

[LeetCode 550](https://leetcode.com/problems/game-play-analysis-iv/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(player_id INTEGER NOT NULL, device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_date TEXT NOT NULL, games_played INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT 0.0 AS fraction;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH first_login AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(event_date) AS fd FROM Activity GROUP BY player_id)
SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) FROM Activity a JOIN first_login f ON a.player_id = f.player_id WHERE a.event_date = DATE(f.fd, "+1 day")) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT player_id), 2) AS fraction FROM Activity;

content.description:
По каждому `query_name`: `quality` = avg(rating/position), `poor_query_percentage` = % rating < 3 (оба округлить 2 знака).

[LeetCode 1211](https://leetcode.com/problems/queries-quality-and-percentage/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Queries(query_name TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT query_name FROM Queries GROUP BY query_name;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT query_name,
  ROUND(AVG(rating * 1.0 / position), 2) AS quality,
  ROUND(SUM(rating < 3) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS poor_query_percentage
FROM Queries GROUP BY query_name;

steps.title: GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY
steps.content:
## Группировка

`HAVING` фильтрует **группы**. `ORDER BY` после `GROUP BY`. Для «ровно один раз» — `HAVING COUNT(*) = 1`.

content.caption: HAVING — WHERE для групп
content.description: Сначала GROUP BY, затем HAVING и ORDER BY.

steps.title: 2356. Number of Unique Subjects Taught by Each Teacher

content.description:
Для каждого `teacher_id` — число **разных** `subject` (`count`); без предметов — не выводить.

[LeetCode 2356](https://leetcode.com/problems/number-of-unique-subjects-taught-by-each-teacher/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Teacher(teacher_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, dept TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT teacher_id, COUNT(subject) AS count FROM Teacher GROUP BY teacher_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT teacher_id, COUNT(DISTINCT subject) AS count FROM Teacher GROUP BY teacher_id;

steps.title: 1141. User Activity for the Past 30 Days I

content.description:
По каждой дате `activity_day`: число **уникальных** `user_id` с активностью. Только даты в пределах 30 дней до «2019-07-27» (включительно).

[LeetCode 1141](https://leetcode.com/problems/user-activity-for-the-past-30-days-i/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, activity_date TEXT NOT NULL, activity_type TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT activity_date AS day, COUNT(user_id) AS active_users FROM Activity GROUP BY activity_date;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT activity_date AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM Activity WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE("2019-07-27", "-29 days") AND "2019-07-27" GROUP BY activity_date ORDER BY day;

content.description:
Первый и последний год продаж каждого `product_id` (`first_year`, `last_year`) — только товары, продававшиеся **≥ 2 разных** года.

[LeetCode 1070](https://leetcode.com/problems/product-sales-analysis-iii/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Sales(sale_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, year INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, MIN(year), MAX(year) FROM Sales GROUP BY product_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT product_id, MIN(year) AS first_year, MAX(year) AS last_year FROM Sales GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) >= 2;

content.description:
Классы (`class`), в которых **≥ 5** **разных** студентов (`student`).

[LeetCode 596](https://leetcode.com/problems/classes-more-than-5-students/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Courses(student TEXT NOT NULL, class TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT class FROM Courses LIMIT 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT class FROM Courses GROUP BY class HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT student) >= 5;

content.description:
Для каждого `user_id` — `followers_count` (число подписчиков). Сортировка: `user_id` по возрастанию.

[LeetCode 1729](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-followers-count/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Followers(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, follower_id INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, COUNT(follower_id) AS followers_count FROM Followers GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT user_id, COUNT(follower_id) AS followers_count FROM Followers GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id;

content.description:
Число, которое встречается **ровно один раз** и больше всех таких; если нет — `NULL` (колонка `num`).

[LeetCode 619](https://leetcode.com/problems/biggest-single-number/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE MyNumbers(num INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT MAX(num) AS num FROM MyNumbers;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT MAX(num) AS num FROM (SELECT num FROM MyNumbers GROUP BY num HAVING COUNT(*) = 1);

content.description:
Клиенты, купившие **все** продукты из каталога `Product`. Колонка `customer_id`.

[LeetCode 1045](https://leetcode.com/problems/customers-who-bought-all-products/)

CREATE TABLE Customer(customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_key INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Product(product_key INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);
content.starterCode: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM Customer;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT customer_id FROM Customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Product);

steps.title: 1731. The Number of Employees Which Report to Each Employee

content.description:
Для каждого менеджера (`employee_id` из `Employees`): `reports_count`, `average_age` (округлить 0 знаков) подчинённых. Только менеджеры с ≥1 подчинённым.

[LeetCode 1731](https://leetcode.com/problems/the-number-of-employees-which-report-to-each-employee/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, employee_name TEXT NOT NULL, reports_to INTEGER, age INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT employee_id, COUNT(*) FROM Employees GROUP BY reports_to;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT e.employee_id, COUNT(r.employee_id) AS reports_count, ROUND(AVG(r.age), 0) AS average_age FROM Employees e JOIN Employees r ON e.employee_id = r.reports_to GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id;

content.description:
Для каждого сотрудника — **основной** отдел: если одна запись в `Employee` — она; если две — где `primary_flag = "Y"`. Колонки: `employee_id`, `department_id`.

[LeetCode 1789](https://leetcode.com/problems/primary-department-for-each-employee/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee(employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL, department_id INTEGER NOT NULL, primary_flag TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT employee_id, department_id FROM Employee;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT employee_id, department_id FROM Employee WHERE primary_flag = "Y" OR employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM Employee GROUP BY employee_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1);

content.description:
Строки `(x,y,z)`, которые могут быть сторонами **нестороннего** треугольника (сумма любых двух > третьей). Колонка `triangle` = «Yes»/«No».

[LeetCode 177](https://leetcode.com/problems/triangle-judgement/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Triangle(x INTEGER NOT NULL, y INTEGER NOT NULL, z INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT x, y, z, "No" AS triangle FROM Triangle;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT x, y, z, CASE WHEN x + y > z AND x + z > y AND y + z > x THEN "Yes" ELSE "No" END AS triangle FROM Triangle;

content.description:
Числа, встречающиеся **≥ 3 раз подряд** (по `id`). Верните `num` **без дубликатов**.

[LeetCode 180](https://leetcode.com/problems/consecutive-numbers/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Logs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, num INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT DISTINCT num FROM Logs;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT l1.num FROM Logs l1 JOIN Logs l2 ON l1.id = l2.id - 1 JOIN Logs l3 ON l2.id = l3.id - 1 WHERE l1.num = l2.num AND l2.num = l3.num;

steps.title: 1164. Product Price at a Given Date

content.description:
Цена каждого `product_id` на «2019-08-16»: последняя известная цена на эту дату или раньше. Колонка `price`.

[LeetCode 1164](https://leetcode.com/problems/product-price-at-a-given-date/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, new_price INTEGER NOT NULL, change_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, new_price AS price FROM Products;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT product_id, FIRST_VALUE(new_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date DESC) AS price FROM Products WHERE change_date <= "2019-08-16";

steps.title: 1204. Last Person to Fit in the Bus

content.description:
Люди садятся в автобус по `turn` по очереди; вместимость 1000 кг. Кто **последний** успел сесть? Колонка `person_name`.

[LeetCode 1204](https://leetcode.com/problems/last-person-to-fit-in-the-bus/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Queue(person_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, person_name TEXT NOT NULL, weight INTEGER NOT NULL, turn INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT person_name FROM Queue ORDER BY turn DESC LIMIT 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT person_name FROM (SELECT person_name, turn, SUM(weight) OVER (ORDER BY turn) AS running FROM Queue) WHERE running <= 1000 ORDER BY turn DESC LIMIT 1;

content.description:
Три категории окладов всех сотрудников: `Low Salary` (<20000), `Average Salary` ([20000,50000]), `High Salary` (>50000). Колонки `category`, `accounts_count` (0 если никого).

[LeetCode 1907](https://leetcode.com/problems/count-salary-categories/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Accounts(account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, income INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT "Low Salary" AS category, COUNT(*) FROM Accounts;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT category, COUNT(a.income) AS accounts_count FROM (SELECT "Low Salary" AS category UNION SELECT "Average Salary" UNION SELECT "High Salary") c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON (c.category = "Low Salary" AND a.income < 20000) OR (c.category = "Average Salary" AND a.income BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000) OR (c.category = "High Salary" AND a.income > 50000) GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;

steps.title: 1773. Employees Whose Manager Left the Company

content.description:
Сотрудники, чей `managerId` **не существует** в таблице (менеджер «уволился»). Колонка `employee_id`.

[LeetCode 1773](https://leetcode.com/problems/employees-whose-manager-left-the-company/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, manager_id INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT employee_id FROM Employees;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT employee_id FROM Employees WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL AND manager_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM Employees);

content.description:
Поменяйте местами соседей: нечётный `id` меняется с `id+1`, последний нечётный остаётся. Колонка `id` (новый порядок), `student`.

[LeetCode 626](https://leetcode.com/problems/exchange-seats/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Seat(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT id, student FROM Seat;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CASE WHEN id % 2 = 1 AND id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM Seat) THEN id WHEN id % 2 = 1 THEN id + 1 ELSE id - 1 END AS id, student FROM Seat ORDER BY id;

content.description:
Две строки, одна колонка `results`: (1) имя пользователя с **наибольшим** числом оценок (при ничьей — по алфавиту); (2) название фильма с **наибольшим средним** рейтингом в **феврале 2020** (при ничьей — по алфавиту).

[LeetCode 1341](https://leetcode.com/problems/movie-rating/)
content.starterCode: SELECT name AS results FROM Users ORDER BY name LIMIT 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT results FROM (SELECT u.name AS results FROM Users u JOIN MovieRating mr ON u.user_id = mr.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, u.name LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT results FROM (SELECT m.title AS results FROM Movies m JOIN MovieRating mr ON m.movie_id = mr.movie_id WHERE strftime("%Y-%m", mr.created_at) = "2020-02" GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title ORDER BY AVG(mr.rating) DESC, m.title LIMIT 1);

content.description:
Скользящая сумма `amount` за **7** дней по `visited_on` (окно из 7 последовательных дней с данными). Колонки `visited_on`, `amount`, `average_amount` (округлить 2). Только даты, от которых есть 7 дней истории.

[LeetCode 1321](https://leetcode.com/problems/restaurant-growth/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Customer(customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, visited_on TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) FROM Customer GROUP BY visited_on;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH daily AS (SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM Customer GROUP BY visited_on)
SELECT d1.visited_on, SUM(d2.amount) AS amount, ROUND(SUM(d2.amount) * 1.0 / 7, 2) AS average_amount FROM daily d1 JOIN daily d2 ON julianday(d2.visited_on) BETWEEN julianday(d1.visited_on) - 6 AND julianday(d1.visited_on) GROUP BY d1.visited_on HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d2.visited_on) = 7 ORDER BY d1.visited_on;

steps.title: 602. Friend Requests II: Who Has the Most Friends

content.description:
Пользователь с **наибольшим** числом друзей (связь в `RequestAccepted` **неориентированная**). Колонка `friend` (id), `friend_count`.

[LeetCode 602](https://leetcode.com/problems/friend-requests-ii-who-has-the-most-friends/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE RequestAccepted(requester_id INTEGER NOT NULL, accepter_id INTEGER NOT NULL, accept_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT requester_id AS friend, COUNT(*) FROM RequestAccepted GROUP BY requester_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT id AS friend, COUNT(*) AS friend_count FROM (SELECT requester_id AS id FROM RequestAccepted UNION ALL SELECT accepter_id FROM RequestAccepted) GROUP BY id ORDER BY friend_count DESC LIMIT 1;

content.description:
Сумма `tiv_2016` полисов, у которых `tiv_2015` **совпадает хотя бы у двух** разных полисов, а пара `(lat, lon)` **уникальна** в таблице (встречается ровно один раз). Колонка `tiv_2016` (округлить 2).

[LeetCode 585](https://leetcode.com/problems/investments-in-2016/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Insurance(pid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tiv_2015 REAL NOT NULL, tiv_2016 REAL NOT NULL, lat REAL NOT NULL, lon REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT 0 AS tiv_2016;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(SUM(tiv_2016), 2) AS tiv_2016 FROM Insurance WHERE (lat, lon) IN (SELECT lat, lon FROM Insurance GROUP BY lat, lon HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) AND tiv_2015 IN (SELECT tiv_2015 FROM Insurance GROUP BY tiv_2015 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

content.description:
Сотрудники, входящие в **топ-3** оклада **в своём** отделе. Колонки: `Department`, `Employee`, `Salary`.

[LeetCode 185](https://leetcode.com/problems/department-top-three-salaries/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, salary INTEGER NOT NULL, departmentId INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Department(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT d.name AS Department, e.name AS Employee, e.salary AS Salary FROM Employee e JOIN Department d ON e.departmentId = d.id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT d.name AS Department, e.name AS Employee, e.salary AS Salary FROM Employee e JOIN Department d ON e.departmentId = d.id WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.salary) FROM Employee e2 WHERE e2.departmentId = e.departmentId AND e2.salary >= e.salary) <= 3 ORDER BY Department, Salary DESC;

steps.title: Строки, REGEXP, DML
steps.content:
## Строки

`SUBSTR`, `||`, `LOWER`/`UPPER`. **`REGEXP`** — JS RegExp. DML с **`checkQuery`**: проверяется состояние таблиц.

content.description:
Имена: первая буква заглавная, остальные строчные. Колонки `user_id`, `name`. Сортировка по `user_id`.

[LeetCode 1667](https://leetcode.com/problems/fix-names-in-a-table/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, name FROM Users;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT user_id, UPPER(SUBSTR(name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(name, 2)) AS name FROM Users ORDER BY user_id;

content.description:
Пациенты с кодом, **начинающимся** с `DIAB1` (коды через пробел). Колонки `patient_id`, `patient_name`, `conditions`.

[LeetCode 1527](https://leetcode.com/problems/patients-with-a-condition/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Patients(patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, patient_name TEXT NOT NULL, conditions TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, conditions FROM Patients WHERE conditions LIKE '%DIAB1%';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, conditions FROM Patients WHERE conditions REGEXP '(^| )DIAB1';

content.description:
Удалите дубликаты `email`, оставив строку с **минимальным** `id`.

[LeetCode 196](https://leetcode.com/problems/delete-duplicate-emails/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Person(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT * FROM Person;
content.referenceSolution: DELETE FROM Person WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM Person GROUP BY email);
content.checkQuery: SELECT id, email FROM Person ORDER BY id;

content.description:
Второй по величине **уникальный** оклад как `SecondHighestSalary`; если нет — одна строка `NULL`.

[LeetCode 176](https://leetcode.com/problems/second-highest-salary/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT salary AS SecondHighestSalary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS SecondHighestSalary;

steps.title: 1484. Group Sold Products By The Date

content.description:
По каждой `sell_date` — строка `sold_num` (число **разных** товаров) и `sold_products` (имена через запятую **по алфавиту**).

[LeetCode 1484](https://leetcode.com/problems/group-sold-products-by-the-date/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activities(sell_date TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT sell_date, product FROM Activities;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT sell_date, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS sold_num, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT product) AS sold_products FROM Activities GROUP BY sell_date ORDER BY sell_date;

steps.title: 1327. List the Products Ordered in a Period

content.description:
Товары с **≥ 100** единиц, заказанных в период «2020-02-01»–«2020-02-28». Колонка `product` (имя), без дубликатов.

[LeetCode 1327](https://leetcode.com/problems/list-the-products-ordered-in-a-period/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, product_category TEXT);
CREATE TABLE Orders(product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_date TEXT NOT NULL, unit INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_name AS product FROM Products;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name AS product FROM Orders o JOIN Products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN "2020-02-01" AND "2020-02-28" GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING SUM(o.unit) >= 100;

content.description:
Валидный email: имя из букв/цифр/`_`, `@`, домен из букв/цифр, `.`, `com|net|org`. Колонки `user_id`, `name`, `mail`.

[LeetCode 1517](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-users-with-valid-e-mails/)

content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, name, mail FROM Users WHERE mail LIKE "%@%.%";

content.question: Как проверяется задача DELETE в этом приложении?
